{{Quote|This investment by the Banking Clan will create unimaginable new war profits. The largest droid factory ever built.''"<br />"''As long as the Republic doesn't find out.|Rush Clovis and Lott Dod conspire on Cato Neimoidia|audio=NewWarProfits-SS.flac|<ref name="Senate Spy" />}}
The '''Geonosis primary droid foundry''' was a [[Geonosis droid factories/Legends|droid foundry]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].

==History==
{{Quote|That looks like a lot of droids''"<br />"''Well, it is a droid factory.''"<br />"''As long as we can destroy them faster than they can make them, we'll come out on top''"<br />"''I love your simple logic, Skywalker''"<br />"''Here we go!|Anakin Skywalker and Luminara Unduli talk while marching to the droid foundry|<ref name="Weapons Factory">{{TCW|Weapons Factory}}</ref>}}
[[File:Foundry_destroyed.png|thumb|left|250px|Poggle the Lesser's foundry is destroyed.]]
Funded by the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] and [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]],<ref name="Senate Spy" /> Geonosian [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] oversaw the construction of this [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shielded]] droid foundry, and saw it as his redemption.<ref name="Point Rain" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] orchestrated an [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|attack]] to dispose of the droid foundry. After the foundry's primary shield was deactivated by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his force, the Republic then planned to attack the foundry.<ref name="Point Rain" />

Poggle and his [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid]], [[TX-21/Legends|TX-21]], remained within the foundry, while the Republic fought Confederate [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and Geonosian fighters outside.<ref name="Weapons Factory" /> However, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] were completing a mission within the [[Geonosian catacombs/Legends|catacombs]] beneath the foundry, given to them by Skywalker and Jedi [[General/Legends|General]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]].<ref name="Weapons Factory" /> The mission was to destroy the main generator of the foundry, which, if destroyed, would cause the entire foundry to collapse to its destruction. The two Padawans were successful, although they had to use a [[Separatist super-tank prototype/Legends|super tank]] to destroy the main generator. While TX-21 was destroyed, Poggle escaped the destruction. The eradication of Poggle's primary droid foundry crippled the Confederacy's advance on the planet, and soon many more droid foundries fell.<ref name="Weapons Factory" />
